metrics.strokeMeasurement: Pinned I straight stem; brush uses a conservative broad-nib design reference, not a claim about every taper.

finish.substrate: paper stock
sequence: paper fibre direction survives printing
gentle stock tone varies across the sheet
actual handled lower region has restrained contact polishing
limits: no added foxing, water damage or yellow vignette without a supported cause
finish.fabricationReliefAssumption: Authored thin applied pigment relief; not missing substrate
finish.coverageInvariant: identical pigment bytes; finish never changes glyph coverage
finish.basis: NPS Preservation Brief 25; CCI metal/wood guidance; project condition study; authored conservative material inference
